name: Creepy Crush
source:
You just moved into a new house in Murderville. It's a nice town, always dark so you don't have to worry about sunburn, but the neighbors are a bit odd. Ranging from a wholesome skeleton to a large, murderous man, go through the town to meet your neighbors, get to know them. Perhaps one will even take you on a date... Or you can kill them.

[From [url=https://creepycollective.itch.io/creepy-crush]Itch.io[/url]]
